description: Fetches NSW Trains line information from nswtrains.fandom.com wiki including train line metadata, station lists, and wiki search.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - search     Search for pages in the wiki by query; requires query parameter
  - get_line   Get train line details including infobox; requires title or pageid
  - get_stations   Get stations table from a train line page; requires title or pageid
  - list_lines   List all train line pages by prefix

query.description: Search query string for the search function

title.description: Page title for get_line or get_stations functions

pageid.description: Page ID for get_line or get_stations functions (alternative to title)

limit.description: Maximum number of results for search or list_lines functions
